verdict.rationale: Fellow is an AI meeting-notes product, so multilingual transcription and summaries are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents transcription, diarized transcripts and summaries ('human-level accuracy'), but nothing on supported languages, non-English meetings or mid-meeting language switching. Absent evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run meetings in languages other than English — transcription and summaries support many languages and handle language switching
